source.limitations: The frozen source adds a test-only copy of the exact prior copy_pages implementation and an ignored native diagnostic. Production candidate has only the coalesced implementation. This component benchmark does not measure complete installation or fork/exec latency.
source.additional_controls: 64 KiB and 1 MiB: both implementations make one copy call.
source.scope: Same-binary original vs coalesced copy into another suspended process. Real FILE_MAP_COPY source and remote PAGE_WRITECOPY views; warm and newly mapped cold destinations. Child never executes guest code. Allocation, validation and process creation are outside timers. Full fork and installation timing are separate.
source.compile_repair: Use MEMORY_MAPPED_VIEW_ADDRESS.Value for pointer operations; UnmapViewOfFile2 keeps the wrapper.

limitations: Tests copy into real remote PAGE_WRITECOPY views of a newly created suspended process. Warm views are reused; cold views are unmapped and freshly mapped before each timed copy. Creation, mapping and full ReadProcessMemory checks are outside timers. Both routes share one binary and use three ABBA rounds per invocation. Host isolation is not guaranteed. Cold differences change sign, so no cold-copy gain is claimed; repeated warm gains support retaining coalescing. This is not a complete fork or installation benchmark.
installation_acceptance_update: R18 completed its historical eight phases but failed debconf preconfiguration, so its 292.443-second time and the historical 185.597-second best are not accepted complete-work comparisons. The remote COW measurements and correctness assertions do not use the guest seed and remain valid. The working-preconfiguration reference is R10 at 215.415 seconds.
